description: This file defines the interface ShuffleExecutorComponents for building shuffle support in Spark Executors, including methods for initialization and creating map output writers.

classes.name: ShuffleExecutorComponents
classes.description: Interface for building shuffle support for Spark Executors, including methods for initialization and creating map output writers.

methods.name: initializeExecutor
methods.description: Bootstraps the executor with application-specific state such as application ID and executor ID.

methods.name: createMapOutputWriter
methods.description: Creates a writer responsible for persisting partitioned bytes for a map task.

methods.name: createSingleFileMapOutputWriter
methods.description: Optional extension to create a map output writer optimized for transferring a single partition file.
